bank.name: Bank
descriptions: A bank of iron counters, a grille, and very little noise.
Warded windows and a clerk who looks up once.

barn.name: Barn
descriptions: A barn, dim and cavernous, stacked to the ridgepole.
Sacks under the eaves and mice in the loft.

bathhouse.name: Bathhouse
descriptions: A bathhouse, steamy and tiled, with plunge pools under a vaulted roof.
Warm water, wet stone, and a keeper handing out towels.

beach.name: Beach
descriptions: Wet sand slopes down to the waterline.
Driftwood and stranded weed mark the tide line.

brothel.name: Brothel
descriptions: A discreet house behind an unmarked door.
Lamplight in an upper window, and no sign at all.

castle.name: Castle
descriptions: A castle: curtain wall, gatehouse, and a keep above the town.
Stone high enough to see the river, and hard to leave.

cemetery.name: Cemetery
descriptions: A cemetery of leaning markers and long grass.
Names cut in stone, and nobody left to read them.

chapel.name: Chapel
descriptions: A small chapel, barely more than a room with a pew.
Plain benches, one window, and a bell rope nobody pulls.

chasm.name: Chasm
descriptions: A crack in the world, too wide to cross and too deep to see.
Cold air rises from a darkness with no visible bottom.

cliff.name: Cliff
descriptions: The ground ends at a sheer drop.
A rock face falls away, wind pulling at the edge.

cottage.name: Cottage
descriptions: A small dwelling with a thatched roof and one door.
A house low to the ground, garden patch behind it.

deep_water.name: Deep Water
descriptions: The bottom drops away into dark, moving water.
Cold water, too deep to stand in.

dense_forest.name: Dense Forest
descriptions: Close-set trunks swallow the light a few steps in.
Underbrush claws at the legs with every stride.

door.name: Door
descriptions: A threshold: not a place of its own, but you go through it.
A doorway between two places, standing open or not.

farmland.name: Farmland
descriptions: Tilled rows run to a low boundary hedge.
Open fields, worked and fenced.

fast_food.name: Fast Food
descriptions: A bright window, a menu board, and tables turned to the wall.
A counter, a queue, and a smell of fried everything.

ferry_landing.name: Ferry Landing
descriptions: A ferry landing: a ramp, a rope, and a boat that comes and goes.
Planks slick with spray, and the river moving past.

hills.name: Hills
descriptions: Rolling ground folds away into shallow valleys.
Windswept grass over hard, stony soil.

infirmary.name: Infirmary
descriptions: An infirmary of low beds and a smell of boiled linen.
Rows of cots, a lamp at each end, and someone breathing hard.

inn.name: Inn
descriptions: An inn with a common room, a kitchen and rooms let by the night.
Beds for the road, and a fire kept low in the hearth.

lake.name: Lake
descriptions: Still water stretches out, flat and grey.
Reeds crowd the shallows at the water's edge.

library.name: Library
descriptions: A library, shelves to the ceiling and long tables under the windows.
Paper, dust, and the particular silence of a reading room.

mall.name: Shopping Mall
descriptions: A covered arcade of many shops under one roof.
Long galleries, escalators, and light that never changes.

mansion.name: Mansion
descriptions: A mansion of many rooms and a garden nobody can afford to keep.
A wide front, a carriage gate, and a garden gone to seed.

market.name: Market
descriptions: A market square, stalls pitched and voices carrying across it.
Trestles, awnings, and produce heaped in crates.

mill.name: Mill
descriptions: A mill turning by the water, sacks waiting on the bank.
A wheel in the race, and the millrace's constant mutter.

mountains.name: Mountains
descriptions: Bare rock climbs in broken steps toward the peaks.
Cold stone and thin air, with scree underfoot.

ocean.name: Ocean
descriptions: Open water to the horizon, restless and salt-heavy.
Long swells roll in under a wide sky.

orchard.name: Orchard
descriptions: An orchard of old trees, grass long under them.
Rows of trees and the smell of fruit in season.

pine_forest.name: Pine Forest
descriptions: Straight pines rise from a hush of fallen needles.
The air smells of resin and cold bark.

ravine.name: Ravine
descriptions: A narrow cut in the land, walls close on either side.
The path threads down through broken rock.

residential.name: Residential
descriptions: A building put to living, with windows lit and washing out.
Dwelling places, shoulder to shoulder along the street.

river.name: River
descriptions: A current runs steadily between its banks.
Water hurries over a stony bed.

river_calm.name: Calm River
descriptions: A slow, wide river winds gently between soft banks.
Placid water glides past with barely a ripple.

river_swift.name: Swift River
descriptions: A powerful current pulls firmly against your legs.
The river surges past, churning around gravel bars.

river_rapids.name: River Rapids
descriptions: White spray erupts as water crashes through jagged rocks.
Foaming chutes race violently down a rocky shelf.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
descriptions: A roaring torrent plunges off a sheer stone precipice.
Thundering water crashes down in a cloud of mist.

ruin.name: Ruin
descriptions: Broken walls half-buried in growth, and no roof left.
A shell of a building, open to the weather.

school.name: School
descriptions: A schoolroom, benches in rows and a slate at the front.
Copybooks and ink, and the noise of a dozen children.

shop.name: Shop
descriptions: A shop with goods stacked to the ceiling and a counter at the door.
A narrow front, a bell over the frame, everything in reach.

shrine.name: Shrine
descriptions: A wayside shrine, small, with offerings left at its foot.
A stone figure under a lean-to, incense and old flowers.

smithy.name: Smithy
descriptions: A smithy open to the street, the forge fire visible from the road.
An anvil, a quench trough, and hammer-sore arms.

sparse_forest.name: Sparse Forest
descriptions: Scattered trees open onto patches of grass.
Thin woodland, easy to walk and hard to hide in.

spring.name: Spring
descriptions: Clear water wells up from the ground, cold and clean.
A small spring seeps out of the hillside.

stable.name: Stable
descriptions: A stable of stalls and tethering rings, warm with animal breath.
Hay, dung, and horses shifting on their feet.

stream.name: Stream
descriptions: A narrow stream chatters over pebbles.
Shallow water threads between mossy stones.

tavern.name: Tavern
descriptions: A taproom loud with talk, a back room quieter, and a door that shuts.
Benches, a bar, and the smell of a fire that never quite goes out.

temple.name: Temple
descriptions: A temple of dressed stone, its doors open onto a dim hall.
Columns, a high roof, and lamps burning along the aisle.

tenement.name: Tenement
descriptions: A block of stacked dwellings sharing stairwells and a courtyard.
Four storeys of windows, laundry on the lines below.

town_hall.name: Town Hall
descriptions: A town hall, its doors open and its notices thick on the board.
A public building, and the queue that forms outside it.

void.name: Void
descriptions: Nothing here  -  a gap, a courtyard, unwalkable. Not a place.
Open air where a place was never made.

wall.name: Wall
descriptions: Solid wall. Nothing passes it and nothing sees through it.
A blank of masonry, thick enough to be a room's own boundary.

warehouse.name: Warehouse
descriptions: A warehouse stacked to the roof with crates and sacks.
Loading doors, rat-holes, and sacks heavy as men.

watch_house.name: Watch House
descriptions: A watch house, small and thick-walled, with a brazier by the door.
A fire, a bench for the guard, and a view of the road.

window.name: Window
descriptions: A window: you can see through it, you cannot walk through it.
Shut against the weather, and a way to see out of the room.

workshop.name: Workshop
descriptions: A workshop, its benches buried under half-made things.
Shavings on the floor and a smell of hot metal and glue.

hallway.name: Hallway
descriptions: A hallway running the length of the place, with doors off both sides.
The passage everyone crosses to get anywhere else, worn pale down the middle.

corridor.name: Corridor
descriptions: A narrow corridor, one person wide, lamps set low in the wall.
A service corridor: bare, straight, and nobody's idea of a destination.

stairway.name: Stairway
descriptions: Stairs: not a place of its own, but you go up or down them.
A flight between two floors, worn hollow in the middle of each tread.

bedroom.name: Bedroom
descriptions: A bedroom, one bed, and a window somebody keeps curtained.
A room built for sleeping in, and for the quiet after.

bunkroom.name: Bunk Room
descriptions: A bunk room, beds in rows and one aisle down the middle.
Sleeping quarters for more people than the building was drawn for.

guest_room.name: Guest Room
descriptions: A guest room, made up and ready for whoever turns up.
The room at the end of the hall that is kept for visitors.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
descriptions: A kitchen, hot from the range and loud from the knife on the board.
Pot, fire, and a table worn pale where the dough is worked.

scullery.name: Scullery
descriptions: A scullery, wet stone floor and everything washed in one place.
The room behind the kitchen where the washing up happens.

dining_hall.name: Dining Hall
descriptions: A dining hall, long tables laid for more than are eating.
Benches the length of the room and a fire at the far end.

mess_hall.name: Mess Hall
descriptions: A mess hall: benches, trays, and the noise of a whole company eating.
Somewhere to sit down and eat, and nowhere to be private about it.

storeroom.name: Storeroom
descriptions: A storeroom, shelves to the ceiling and a list nailed to the door.
Crates, sacks, and a room that smells of keeping things dry.

cellar.name: Cellar
descriptions: A cellar, cold and low, reached by steps that lose the light.
Barrels below the floor, and the damp that never quite leaves.

pantry.name: Pantry
descriptions: A pantry, jars ranked on shelves, everything used by date.
Flour, salt, and the food kept for the days nobody planned for.

armory.name: Armoury
descriptions: An armoury: racks of arms, each one signed out to somebody.
Spears, blades and shields, and a ledger of who has what.

workroom.name: Workroom
descriptions: A workroom, benches cleared for whatever is being made this week.
Half-finished things on every surface, and shavings underfoot.

forge.name: Forge
descriptions: A forge, the fire banked and the anvil cold until morning.
Soot on the walls, a quench trough, and the heat that never quite leaves.

oratory.name: Oratory
descriptions: An oratory, a few benches and a lectern, kept plain on purpose.
A small room for prayer, where the speaking is done by one person.

crypt.name: Crypt
descriptions: A crypt, niches cut into the walls and stone that holds the cold.
Under the floor, out of the weather, and not often visited.

classroom.name: Classroom
descriptions: A classroom, benches in rows facing a board nobody has cleaned.
Desks in ranks, a lectern, and the smell of chalk and old paper.

study.name: Study
descriptions: A study, one desk, and more paper than shelf.
Somewhere to write things down that are not for everyone.

archive.name: Archive
descriptions: An archive, shelves of ledgers going back further than anyone remembers.
Records kept dry, indexed, and consulted by people who no longer need them.

stall.name: Stall
descriptions: A market stall, the day's goods out and the day's takings counted.
A board, a cloth, and a trade that depends on where you set it up.

counting_house.name: Counting House
descriptions: A counting house, ledgers open and a clerk who never looks up.
Where the money is counted and the debts are written down.

guardroom.name: Guard Room
descriptions: A guard room, a stove, and a bench nobody is meant to sleep on.
Where the watch sits between turns, close enough to hear the door.

washroom.name: Wash Room
descriptions: A wash room, tubs and a stone floor that is always damp.
Where the washing happens, and where the hot water runs out first.

latrine.name: Latrine
descriptions: A latrine, one seat, a bucket, and a door that latches from the inside.
The smallest room in the building and the one nobody volunteers for.

laundry.name: Laundry
descriptions: A laundry, sheets over lines and the whole room damp to the shoulder.
Boiling water, soap, and more washing than there are hands for.

porch.name: Porch
descriptions: A porch under the roof, dry to wait on and open to the weather.
The step inside, where the rain stops and the door is still shut.

courtyard.name: Courtyard
descriptions: A courtyard walled on three sides, with the sky straight overhead.
Open to the air and closed to the road, and warmer than the rooms.

balcony.name: Balcony
descriptions: A balcony, narrow enough that two people cannot pass on it.
Out over the drop, with a rail and a long way down past it.

bathroom.name: Bathroom
descriptions: A bathroom, a tub and a stone floor that is always damp.
Water, a mirror gone spotty, and somewhere to shut the door.

hearth_room.name: Hearth Room
descriptions: A hearth room: the fire, a long settle, and the whole family in it.
The warmest room in the house and the one everybody ends up in.

parlour.name: Parlour
descriptions: A parlour, kept for guests and rarely sat in.
Good chairs nobody leans on, and a fire laid but not lit.

taproom.name: Tap Room
descriptions: A tap room, wet boards and the noise of everyone in the place.
A bar down one side, benches down the other, and no quiet corner.

great_hall.name: Great Hall
descriptions: A great hall, tall enough that a voice carries to the far wall.
One long table, a fire at each end, and a ceiling nobody here can reach.

council_chamber.name: Council Chamber
descriptions: A council chamber, a horseshoe of tables and the argument going round it.
Seats ranked by who arrived first, and minutes kept of who said what.

nave.name: Nave
descriptions: A nave, the length of the building, with the windows high up.
Pews in rows and a walk down the middle nobody needs to walk.

vestry.name: Vestry
descriptions: A vestry, where the vestments are kept and the door is shut.
Robes on pegs, a chest, and a lamp burning low.

ward.name: Ward
descriptions: A ward, beds in rows and someone moving quietly between them.
Where the hurt are put, and where the smell of vinegar never quite goes.

cell_block.name: Cell Block
descriptions: A cell block, a corridor of doors and the sound of somebody not asleep.
Doors down one side, a barred window at the end, and a guard's stool.

dungeon.name: Dungeon
descriptions: A dungeon, below the waterline, and colder than the stair that leads to it.
Vaulted and low, with rings set in the floor and nothing else down here.

hayloft.name: Hayloft
descriptions: A hayloft, reached by a ladder, smelling of dust and dry grass.
Hay up to the eaves and one small window to throw the bales down from.

animal_pen.name: Animal Pen
descriptions: A pen, fenced at knee height, with the ground worn to mud in the middle.
Fodder on the ground, a gate that latches, and the noise of animals at rest.

tack_room.name: Tack Room
descriptions: A tack room: bridles on pegs, saddles on racks, everything oiled and hung.
Harness and mending, all of it labelled in somebody's careful hand.

stacks.name: Stacks
descriptions: Stacks, shelf after shelf, and a ladder that has to be moved to reach them.
Books in runs nobody has straightened since the last flood.

shopfront.name: Shop Front
descriptions: A shop front: a counter, a door that rings, and the street coming in cold.
Goods on shelves at eye level and the good stock somewhere out the back.

office.name: Office
descriptions: An office: a desk, a window onto the yard, and a door that shuts.
Paperwork, and a clerk who has worked out which visitors waste their time.

mill_room.name: Mill Room
descriptions: A mill room, the wheels turning and the whole floor shaking with it.
Mechanism, flour to the ankle, and a noise you learn to talk over.

gallery.name: Gallery
descriptions: A gallery, hung floor to ceiling, lit to flatter what is on the wall.
Rooms read as a walk, each doorway the start of the next one.

vault.name: Vault
descriptions: A vault, below ground, behind a door with more than one lock on it.
Iron doors, a wheel handle, and shelves nobody has opened in years.

reading_room.name: Reading Room
descriptions: A reading room, long tables, and the rule that nobody speaks.
Desks under lamps, a ledger of who has had which volume out.

assembly_hall.name: Assembly Hall
descriptions: An assembly hall, benches filling up and a platform nobody is using yet.
Enough chairs for the whole town, arranged to be argued at from both sides.

altar_room.name: Altar Room
descriptions: The altar room, behind the screen, where only the celebrant stands.
A raised step, a table with cloth over it, and a door that stays shut.

yard_room.name: Yard Room
descriptions: A yard room  -  half roofed, open to the weather, and the busiest part of the place.
A lean-to with benches under it and a yard to work in.

gas_station.name: Gas Station
descriptions: A roadside gas station under buzzing fluorescent canopies.
Pumps smelling of fuel, asphalt grease, and a flickering convenience sign.

convenience_store.name: Convenience Store
descriptions: A fluorescent-lit convenience shop lined with candy, energy drinks, and packaged snacks.
Shelves crowded with tobacco, lottery tickets, and refrigerated soda cases.

diner.name: Diner
descriptions: A chrome-edged diner with vinyl booths and the smell of stale coffee and bacon grease.
Checkered tile, a long counter with swivel stools, and pie cases on display.

motel.name: Motel
descriptions: A low-slung roadside motel with exterior catwalks and cheap curtains.
Numbered doors facing an asphalt lot under a humming neon sign.

police_station.name: Police Station
descriptions: A municipal precinct desk with bullet-resistant glass and dispatch radios crackling.
Cinderblock corridors, holding cells, and desks piled with incident reports.

fire_station.name: Fire Station
descriptions: An engine bay with polished concrete, high bay doors, and hanging turnout gear.
Ladders, hose racks, and the heavy diesel smell of fire engines.

pharmacy.name: Pharmacy
descriptions: A clean drugstore counter lined with prescription bottles and first-aid supplies.
Sanitized aisles stocked with antiseptics, pills, and medical sundries.

post_office.name: Post Office
descriptions: A postal branch with rows of metal PO boxes and parcel scales behind a wicket.
Sorting bins, cancellation stamps, and stacks of padded envelopes.

hardware_store.name: Hardware Store
descriptions: A sprawling hardware shop smelling of cut timber, motor oil, and galvanized nails.
Aisles of power tools, plumbing fixtures, and coils of heavy chain.

supermarket.name: Supermarket
descriptions: A large grocery store with wide lanes, hum of refrigeration, and produce stands.
Endcaps stacked with canned goods, cereal boxes, and checkout conveyor belts.

auto_repair.name: Auto Repair
descriptions: A service garage with hydraulic vehicle lifts, impact wrenches, and oil catch pans.
Tire stacks, diagnostic machines, and tools hanging on pegboards.

laundromat.name: Laundromat
descriptions: A self-service laundromat with coin-operated washers churning soapy water.
Row upon row of tumble dryers emitting heat, lint, and chemical detergent scent.

football_field.name: Football Field
descriptions: A marked regulation turf field flanked by goalposts and tall floodlight masts.
Chalk yard lines stretching across green grass under the stadium lights.

bleachers.name: Bleachers
descriptions: Tiered spectator benches overlooking the track and playing field.
Aluminium and timber planks hollow-sounding under running footsteps.

running_track.name: Running Track
descriptions: An oval cinder track looping around the open sports field.
White lane markers painted onto compressed all-weather track rubber.

parking_lot.name: Parking Lot
descriptions: A wide expanse of cracked asphalt with painted yellow stall lines.
Parked student cars, speed bumps, and light poles casting harsh sodium glare.

courtyard_quad.name: Courtyard Quad
descriptions: A landscaped campus green crisscrossed by paved walkways between academic wings.
Benches beneath shade trees where students congregate between bells.

bus_loop.name: Bus Loop
descriptions: A curved concrete loop designated for school bus drop-offs and pick-ups.
Yellow curb markings, idle diesel exhaust, and student crossing queues.

gymnasium.name: Gymnasium
descriptions: A high-ceilinged athletic gym with polished hardwood basketball courts and retracted bleachers.
Echoing dribbles, scoreboard banners, and climbing ropes coiled near rafters.

auditorium.name: Auditorium
descriptions: A tiered assembly hall with rows of folding cushioned seats facing a raised proscenium stage.
Heavy velvet stage curtains, spot lanterns, and acoustic wall paneling.

conservatory.name: Conservatory
descriptions: A glass-roofed botanical conservatory sheltering exotic ferns, orchids, and iron plant stands.
Steamy glass panes, smelling of damp potting loam, jasmine, and decaying petals.

carriage_house.name: Carriage House
descriptions: A stone outbuilding with high coach doors, horse harness pegs, and oily tool chests.
Cobblestone floors, iron wheel rims, and horse-drawn carriages covered in dust sheets.

gatehouse.name: Gatehouse
descriptions: A fortified entrance lodge framing wrought-iron estate gates.
Heavy oak timbers, porter arrow-slits, and a heavy brass bell.

mausoleum.name: Mausoleum
descriptions: A classical stone sepulchre bearing ancestral names carved in decaying relief.
Iron grilles, weeping marble slabs, and cold stagnant air.

gazebo.name: Gazebo
descriptions: An octagonal painted timber pavilion nestled in the estate grounds.
Lattice railing, climbing ivy, and a view over the lawn.

hedge_maze.name: Hedge Maze
descriptions: A dense labyrinth of manicured ten-foot yew hedges with blind turns.
Gravel paths disappearing into shadowed corners where birds fall silent.

formal_garden.name: Formal Garden
descriptions: Geometric parterres lined with trimmed box hedges, rose beds, and marble sundials.
Crushed gravel paths leading past classical stone urns and birdbaths.

goblin_palisade.name: Goblin Palisade
descriptions: A defensive wall of sharpened timber stakes bound with rawhide and wire.
Crude firing platforms, spiked logs, and mud-daubed battlements.

chieftain_tent.name: Chieftain Tent
descriptions: An enormous hide pavilion hung with war trophies, wolf skins, and cracked shields.
A central firepit surrounded by coarse cushions, skulls, and curved cleavers.

shaman_hovel.name: Shaman Hovel
descriptions: A crooked shack hung with dried bone talismans, bundle roots, and pungent feathers.
Smoking braziers, clay bowls of foul mash, and dried herbs hanging from willow struts.

mess_tent.name: Mess Tent
descriptions: A greasy canvas shelter housing iron cook-pots over roaring hearth trenches.
Gnawed bones underfoot, wooden trenchers, and the smell of boiled offal.

loot_pit.name: Loot Pit
descriptions: A reinforced trench filled with plundered wagons, battered iron, and sacked bundles.
Guarded crates, salvaged chains, and rusted weapons tossed in heaps.

guard_tower.name: Guard Tower
descriptions: A rough-hewn wooden observation tower with notched ladders and an overhanging deck.
A vantage point equipped with warning horns, torches, and heavy javelins.

archery_range.name: Archery Range
descriptions: A firing lane backed by straw butts and riddled timber targets.
Split arrows, discarded bowstrings, and shooting stakes driven into the mud.

tannery.name: Tannery
descriptions: A pungent workshop with scraping beams, lime vats, and stretched beast hides.
Acrid tanning liquors, drying racks, and heaps of raw animal pelts.

apothecary.name: Apothecary
descriptions: A shop crowded with dried herbs, glass retorts, pestles, and tincture jars.
Shelves of labeled powders, hanging lavender bundles, and simmering copper kettles.

classroom_science_lab.name: Science Lab
descriptions: A high school chemistry laboratory with black slate workbenches, gas taps, and glass beakers.
Bunsen burners, fume hoods, and charts of the periodic table taped to tile walls.

locker_room.name: Locker Room
descriptions: Rows of dented metal lockers lining communal shower benches smelling of disinfectant.
Moist tiled floors, athletic tape on the benches, and echoing ventilation vents.

cafeteria.name: Cafeteria
descriptions: A cavernous lunch hall with long folding laminate tables and plastic trash bins.
Stainless steel serving lines, milk cartons, and grease vapors from warming trays.

nurse_office.name: Nurse Office
descriptions: A small clinic bay with vinyl cots, privacy curtains, and ice-pack coolers.
First aid kits, blood-pressure cuffs, and a locked glass medicine cabinet.

principal_office.name: Principal Office
descriptions: A carpeted administrative office dominated by an imposing faux-oak desk.
Framed diplomas, disciplinary logs, and security intercom monitors on the credenza.

detention_room.name: Detention Room
descriptions: A barren classroom where delinquent students sit in silent rows under a ticking wall clock.
Graffiti-scratched desks and blinds drawn shut against the afternoon sunlight.

boiler_room.name: Boiler Room
descriptions: A subterranean mechanical chamber humming with massive water boilers and wrapped pipes.
Steam hissing from relief valves, concrete dust, and electrical breaker panels.

motel_room.name: Motel Room
descriptions: A cramped motel room with floral bedspreads, a humming cathode television, and a noisy AC unit.
Stained commercial carpet, cheap particleboard nightstands, and thin adjoining walls.

diner_booth_floor.name: Diner Booth Floor
descriptions: A dining room floor fitted with crimson vinyl booths, chrome napkin dispensers, and salt shakers.
Linoleum walkway between tables where waitresses balance heavy breakfast plates.

convenience_aisle.name: Convenience Aisle
descriptions: A narrow grocery aisle flanked by wire chip racks, soda coolers, and discount magazines.
Fluorescent strips buzzing overhead above scuffed linoleum tiles.

ballroom.name: Ballroom
descriptions: A grand ballroom with polished parquet floors, gilt chandeliers, and mirrored walls.
Tall French doors opening onto estate terraces under vaulted fresco ceilings.

drawing_room.name: Drawing Room
descriptions: A formal parlor with brocade settees, a carved marble fireplace, and oil portraits.
Heavy velvet drapery muffling sound, with tea services arranged on low mahogany tables.

billiard_room.name: Billiard Room
descriptions: A gentleman recreation parlor housing a full-sized slate billiard table under green lamps.
Cue racks, chalk dust, and leather armchairs smelling of tobacco smoke.

servants_quarters.name: Servants Quarters
descriptions: A plain attic bedroom with narrow iron cot frames and simple washstands.
Bare floorboards, pitched dormer ceilings, and wool blankets folded neatly.

wine_cellar.name: Wine Cellar
descriptions: A subterranean stone vault filled with timber bins and dusty vintage bottles.
Cool damp masonry, smelling of aging oak barrels and tart wine dregs.

attic.name: Attic
descriptions: A shadowy crawlspace beneath heavy rafters stacked with steamer trunks and disused furniture.
Cobwebs veiling discarded family heirlooms and dust motes dancing in dormer shafts.

master_suite.name: Master Suite
descriptions: An opulent bedchamber dominated by a four-poster canopy bed and silk beddings.
Private hearth, writing bureau, and plush rugs cushioning every footstep.

dressing_room.name: Dressing Room
descriptions: An anteroom fitted with mahogany wardrobes, full-length cheval mirrors, and hatboxes.
Perfume atomizers, velvet-lined jewelry trays, and tailored garments on mannequins.

morning_room.name: Morning Room
descriptions: An east-facing breakfast salon flooded with early daylight through leaded bay windows.
Chintz-covered chairs, a writing desk, and botanical prints upon paneled walls.

fungus_grotto.name: Fungus Grotto
descriptions: A subterranean hollow teeming with luminous cap mushrooms and spore-spewing shelf fungi.
Damp loam, pale phosphorescent glow, and spongy lichen carpets.

gathering_pit.name: Gathering Pit
descriptions: A sunken circular dirt arena where tribal warriors assemble to argue and celebrate.
Tamped clay steps, blackened embers from ceremonial fires, and trampled filth.

slave_pens.name: Slave Pens
descriptions: Iron-barred enclosures sunk into cold stone and mud to hold captive workers.
Chains pinned to bedrock, fouled straw, and crude wooden stockades.

mine_shaft.name: Mine Shaft
descriptions: A timber-braced tunnel penetrating deep rock, tracked with narrow ore cart rails.
Pick marks along vein walls, dripping water, and oil lantern hooks.

smelting_trench.name: Smelting Trench
descriptions: A scorching stone hall housing bellows-driven ore furnaces and slag channels.
Bellows groaning, glowing molten metal puddles, and choking sulfurous smoke.

underground_wharf.name: Underground Wharf
descriptions: A damp wooden jetty moored beside a black subterranean river channel.
Mooring rings driven into wet cavern walls, cargo crates, and silent flatboats.

ritual_chamber.name: Ritual Chamber
descriptions: A sanctum carved with archaic runes and centered upon an inscribed basalt altar.
Channeling grooves in the flagstones, cold braziers, and dried incense resin.

oak_forest.name: Oak Forest
descriptions: A mature oak canopy casting dappled shade across deep leaf litter.
Thick gnarled trunks, mossy hollows, and acorns scattered over the ground.

birch_forest.name: Birch Forest
descriptions: A bright woodland of pale, papery birch trunks rustling with fine leaves.
Slender trees admitting ample sun to brush, berry thickets, and grasses below.

maple_forest.name: Maple Forest
descriptions: A dense broadleaf woodland rich with sap, broad leaves, and deep loam.
A cathedral of broad branches turning vivid scarlet and gold in autumn.

old_growth_forest.name: Old-Growth Forest
descriptions: An ancient forest of colossal ancient trees, fallen nurse logs, and thick moss mantles.
Multiple towering canopy layers shutting out the sky, alive with fungal networks.

temperate_rainforest.name: Temperate Rainforest
descriptions: A saturated woodland where giant evergreens drip with rain and thick moss shrouds.
Enormous ferns, nurse logs, and dense wet foliage absorbing all distant sound.

young_regrowth.name: Young Regrowth
descriptions: A tangled thicket of vigorous saplings, briars, and berry bushes recovering from clearing.
Sunlit brush crowded with blackberry brambles, tender shoots, and young poles.

floodplain_forest.name: Floodplain Forest
descriptions: A lowland river forest periodically inundated by seasonal high water.
Silt-stained tree bases, exposed root masses, and fertile mud deposits.

taiga.name: Taiga
descriptions: A vast subarctic coniferous expanse of spruce, fir, and spongy lichen.
Acidic soil blanketed in dark pine needles under cold northern winds.

tundra.name: Tundra
descriptions: A windswept, treeless expanse of dwarf shrubs, sedges, and frost-heaved turf.
Permafrost beneath a thin carpet of reindeer moss and hardy alpine berries.

snowfield.name: Snowfield
descriptions: A glaring, unbroken sheet of hard-packed perpetual snow and ice.
Winds scouring sastrugi ridges across a blinding, frozen horizon.

tropical_rainforest.name: Tropical Rainforest
descriptions: An impenetrable humid jungle beneath a continuous multi-tiered canopy.
Hanging lianas, buttress roots, screeching birds, and endless warm rain.

jungle.name: Jungle
descriptions: A dense tropical tangled forest choked with vines, bamboo, and broadleaf palms.
Sweating heat, buzzing insects, and sharp thorned undergrowth.

mangrove_forest.name: Mangrove Forest
descriptions: A tidal coastal forest supported by arching stilt roots above brackish mud.
Tangled root mazes trapping tidal debris, crabs, and wading birds.

bamboo_forest.name: Bamboo Forest
descriptions: A dense grove of towering green bamboo culms clattering together in the breeze.
Filtered green light falling upon fallen sheath leaves and shooting spears.

grassland.name: Grassland
descriptions: Rolling open plains of wild prairie grasses rippling under the sky.
Expansive meadows dotted with clover, wildflowers, and grazing tracks.

prairie.name: Prairie
descriptions: Tall grass prairie with stems rising chest-high across endless horizons.
Deep fertile soils supporting dense root masses and soaring songbirds.

steppe.name: Steppe
descriptions: A dry, semi-arid shortgrass plain sweeping toward distant mountain ranges.
Wind-scoured turf, dry soil, and expansive unimpeded vistas.

savanna.name: Savanna
descriptions: Sun-baked grasslands punctuated by solitary flat-topped acacia and baobab trees.
Golden dry-season grass trampled along migratory game paths.

alpine_meadow.name: Alpine Meadow
descriptions: A high-altitude pasture brilliant with blooming alpine gentians and herbs.
Short lush grass clinging to mountain slopes just below the bare rock line.

moorland.name: Moorland
descriptions: An undulating upland of purple heather, bracken fern, and wet peat soils.
Misty rolling ridges, hidden mires, and cold biting winds.

heathland.name: Heathland
descriptions: Open dwarf-shrub heathland dominated by gorse, heather, and sandy tracks.
Low shrubs humming with bees under bright sun and dry breezes.

freshwater_marsh.name: Freshwater Marsh
descriptions: A shallow wetland of reeds, cattails, and open water pools buzzing with dragonflies.
Spongy reed tussocks resting over soft, organic waterlogged muck.

swamp.name: Swamp
descriptions: A drowned forest where gnarled cypress trees rise from stagnant tea-colored water.
Spanish moss hanging from boughs above submerged logs and lurking predators.

bog.name: Bog
descriptions: An acidic peat mire carpeted in sphagnum moss and carnivorous sundew plants.
Unstable quaking peat mats covering dark, bottomless cold pools.

fen.name: Fen
descriptions: A mineral-fed wetland rich in sedges, rushes, and slow winding streams.
Nutrient-rich marshy soil supporting waving grasses and nesting waterfowl.

floodplain.name: Floodplain
descriptions: Broad flat valley land shaped by recurrent river inundations.
Rich alluvial soils deposited across verdant meadows and seasonal channels.

sand_desert.name: Sand Desert
descriptions: A sea of wind-sculpted sand dunes shimmering under blinding solar glare.
Cresting sand ridges shifting constantly under scorching desert gales.

rocky_desert.name: Rocky Desert
descriptions: A stark desert floor of fractured stone, gravel reg, and sun-blackened boulders.
Weathered rock terraces devoid of shade, crackling in baking heat.

salt_flat.name: Salt Flat
descriptions: An ancient evaporated lakebed encrusted with hexagonal white salt crystals.
Blinding white expanse stretching to the horizon with zero vegetation.

oasis.name: Oasis
descriptions: A lush sanctuary of date palms and clear spring water surrounded by barren dunes.
Cool shade, blooming reeds, and refreshing water in the heart of the desert.

mountain_pass.name: Mountain Pass
descriptions: A high saddle cut between sheer peaks, exposed to whistling gale-force winds.
A narrow winding trail hemmed in by looming rock walls and yawning drops.

glacier.name: Glacier
descriptions: A massive river of blue-green glacial ice groaning under enormous internal pressure.
Jagged seracs, meltwater channels, and lethal hidden crevasses.

scree.name: Scree
descriptions: A steep slope of loose, fractured rock fragments shifting under every step.
Unstable gravel and broken shale clattering downhill toward valley floors.

limestone_cave.name: Limestone Cave
descriptions: A dissolution cavern draped in stalactites, flowstone drapes, and mineral pillars.
Echoing water droplets striking underground stone pools in deep stillness.

natural_cavern.name: Natural Cavern
descriptions: A vast subterranean vault of rough unworked stone carved by primeval forces.
Towering vaulted rock ceilings lost in shadow above jagged boulder piles.

underground_river.name: Underground River
descriptions: A swift subterranean river roaring through a subterranean limestone channel.
Black foaming water rushing between polished rock banks in absolute dark.

lava_tube.name: Lava Tube
descriptions: A smooth cylindrical conduit formed by long-drained basaltic lava flows.
Vitreous glazed rock walls, slag ripples, and dark cavern floors.

burned_forest.name: Burned Forest
descriptions: A desolate stand of charred timber snags rising from black ash and soot.
Soot-stained soil, crumbling charcoal stumps, and haunting silence.

badlands.name: Badlands
descriptions: An intensely eroded landscape of banded clay hills, canyons, and dry gullies.
Fragile shale ridges, exposed fossil beds, and harsh barren ravines.

canyon.name: Canyon
descriptions: A colossal fissure cut into plateau bedrock by eons of water erosion.
Sheer banded rock cliffs plunging hundreds of paces to a shadowed floor.

overgrown_temple_ruin.name: Overgrown Temple Ruin
descriptions: Cracked marble columns and fallen pediments bound by strangler figs and ivy.
Weathered inscriptions on mossy altars where lost rites were once performed.

ancient_battlefield.name: Ancient Battlefield
descriptions: A scarred moor strewn with rusted iron armor flakes, spearheads, and burial barrows.
Trenches grown over with wild grasses, holding silent memories of slaughter.

road.name: Road
descriptions: A worn track cut through the land.

bridge.name: Bridge
descriptions: A span carries the road over the gap.

ford.name: Ford
descriptions: The road drops through shallow water here.

tunnel.name: Tunnel
descriptions: A bored passage runs through the rock.

town.name: Town
descriptions: A dense knot of streets and roofs.

village.name: Village
descriptions: A handful of buildings around a common.

building.name: Building
descriptions: A single roofed structure with walls and a door.

ruin.name: Ruin
ruin.entry_phrase: climb in through the broken wall
ruin.exit_phrase: climb back out of the ruin
descriptions: Broken walls half-buried in growth.

gate.name: Gate
descriptions: A gate bars the road between posts.
